text:
In crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs, the function that builds the throughput design request (the StewardRequest::new call near the 'Predicted saving' template) gives only "docs/design/" as its files. Add CHANGELOG.md to that list, so the reading does not write a criterion that forbids the changelog the changelog default requires. Add a test that builds a design request and checks that its Files line includes CHANGELOG.md. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry. What I read: in five rejected throughput design jobs (fsaz, kxrd, r796, ggxj, r241), verification.json has a finding about CHANGELOG.md, either missing or forbidden by a criterion.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Throughput design requests list only docs/design/ as files, so the criteria fight the changelog default and design jobs are rejected
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs, docs/design/, CHANGELOG.md, verification.json
